settings.Discovery never executes a candidate. Dr: Discovery never executes a candidate. Drafts move through isolated testing and review before publication; published snapshots are immutable and can be rolled back.
settings.Fetch current weather and forecast data: Fetch current weather and forecast data for Seoul.
settings.A manual price sheet, one row per provid: A manual price sheet, one row per provider/model actually priced -- nothing populates this automatically, there is no live pricing API this reads from. Only a priced model's calls get a real

settings.No connections yet. Add one so agents ca: No connections yet. Add one so agents can call an external API with a stored credential.
settings.A named, versioned, reusable \"how to do: A named, versioned, reusable "how to do X" an agent can be granted (permission type
settings.). Success rate is a format-validity sig: ). Success rate is a format-validity signal -- did the reply parse into a valid action -- not a judgment of whether the answer was actually correct.
settings.Runs an agent against a goal on a recurr: Runs an agent against a goal on a recurring interval -- each firing starts a brand-new session (visible in Activity -> Sessions), the same as sending it a message by hand. A schedule's run count/last run/last session
settings.No schedules yet. A schedule runs an age: No schedules yet. A schedule runs an agent on a goal at a regular interval; add one below.
settings.No token set for this browser tab. If th: No token set for this browser tab. If the server requires one, requests will return 401.
settings.No name set -- audit log entries will sh: No name set -- audit log entries will show as unlabeled. This is self-reported, not authentication: anyone with the token can type any name.
settings.English is the default. Other languages: English is the default. Other languages come from translation packs (files in web/i18n); anything without a translation stays in English.
settings.No models added yet. Add one by name, or: No models added yet. Add one by name, or from what the server lists.
settings.Test the connection to list what the ser: Test the connection to list what the server offers.

settings.Also make it the model new agents start: Also make it the model new agents start with
settings.Each provider's models. Switch a model o: Each provider's models. Switch a model off to stop it being put on agents, and use Use on agents… to give a model to every agent or to chosen ones, and to functions and procedures. Only the provider and model change; each agent's instructions and limits stay. What each one had before is kept in the audit log. System agents are never changed.
settings.US dollars per 1,000 tokens. Only a pric: US dollars per 1,000 tokens. Only a priced model's calls count toward a cost limit.

People.Create or promote another admin first: Create or promote another admin first
People.Without a rule, an approval or proposal: Without a rule, an approval or proposal is decided as before: by an admin, or by a user assigned to the agent. A rule sends matching requests to a role; the agent's own user can then see the request but not decide it.
People.No rules yet. Without a rule, an admin o: No rules yet. Without a rule, an admin or the user assigned to the agent decides. Add one below to route requests to a role.
People.No roles yet. A role names who is respon: No roles yet. A role names who is responsible for decisions, for example Marketing head.
People.Deleting a role also deletes the rules t: Deleting a role also deletes the rules that name it. A request already routed to it can then be decided only by an admin.
People.No units yet. Units are optional departm: No units yet. Units are optional departments or teams that a role can belong to.
People.While a delegation is active, the second: While a delegation is active, the second person may decide what the first person's roles decide.

Decision.No decision is handed to it:: No decision is handed to it:
Decision.every decision point stays with people a: every decision point stays with people and rules until you turn delegation on for that point, and the decisions people make keep being recorded either way.
Decision.Key (the server's LAYA_API_KEY, if it ha: Key (the server's LAYA_API_KEY, if it has one)
Decision.The server is on this machine or a priva: The server is on this machine or a private network
Decision.No decision model connected. Everything: No decision model connected. Everything is decided by people and rules.
Decision.A write or physical tool, and approving: A write or physical tool, and approving a proposal, are always a person's.
Decision.Decide whether to approve this request f: Decide whether to approve this request from an agent to run or continue.
Decision.Hand over unlocks after at least 10 comp: Hand over unlocks after at least 10 compared decisions with 80% agreement. Watch first.
Decision.Train and evaluate outside Allgres with: Train and evaluate outside Allgres with laya-train and laya-evals, then paste the JSON report here. Switching this point to that checkpoint needs a report that meets the bar (accuracy ≥ 0.8, calibration error ≤ 0.1).
Decision.Decide whether to approve this change th: Decide whether to approve this change that an agent proposed.
Decision.Decide whether this task that the room's: Decide whether this task that the room's lead proposed should be started.
Nothing has been asked of the model yet.
Decision.Connect a decision model above to use it: Connect a decision model above to use it. Until then every decision waits for a person.
Decision.Each decision point below has its own se: Each decision point below has its own setting. Turn the decision model off to leave all of them with people at once; the settings are kept.
Decision.The decision model is off: nothing below: The decision model is off: nothing below is asked of it and every decision waits for a person. Each point keeps its setting for when you turn it on again.
Decision.Decisions that wait for a person are in: Decisions that wait for a person are in the Approvals menu.
Decision.An agent asks to run or continue: An agent asks to run or continue
Decision.A person is asked to approve or reject a: A person is asked to approve or reject a request from an agent: a tool run, a limit raised, a step that needs a decision.
A person is asked to approve or reject a change an agent proposed: a new function, a setting, a document.
Decision.The lead of a room proposes a task; a pe: The lead of a room proposes a task; a person confirms it before it starts.
Decision.Who in the team takes work that someone: Who in the team takes work that someone else handed over, or that nobody does.
Decision.read before the model, in this order: read before the model, in this order
Decision.The first rule whose conditions all hold: The first rule whose conditions all hold decides. A rule can decide, ask the model, or send the item to a person. What no rule matches goes on to the model, and from there to a person. A rule that approves must say who or what it is about and is saved only after you confirm it.
